verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents an MCP server for coding agents with OAuth 2.1 authentication and tools to list services and run SQL. It also exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface for programmatic query and result retrieval, and CHKit provides typed describe/validate commands an agent can drive. Governance is covered by role scoping down to table and column, isolated read-only agent compute, and full per-query logging. Missing for 10: an explicit schema-discovery tool in the MCP surface (listing is documented only at the service level, with schema discovery implied through SQL/CHKit), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.
